rationale: I read the held original of EO 10733 (22 FR 8135, October 10, 1957) in full and confirmed identity: it only amends section 3 of EO 10479 to enlarge the Government Contract Committee and add an Executive Vice Chairman. The held official text of EO 10925 (26 FR 1977) sec. 403 revokes EO 10479 'together with Executive Orders Nos. 10482 ... and 10733 of October 10, 1957 (22 F.R. 8135), amending that order', abolishes the Committee and transfers its records and property, and sec. 402 makes the order effective thirty days after execution on March 6, 1961 (1961-04-05); the dossier's 'target provision not located' gap is filled by this located sec. 403. A literal search of held texts for 10733 and a cruden search for the parent EO 10479 found no earlier revocation of either, so status no is supported through 2026-10-14. Every evidence record's held text was re-hashed against its recorded text_sha256 and every recorded span was compared with the held file (all matched); the producer's two history observations were checked against the held texts and no history flags require resolution.
